observations.body: Jesus follows his custom to the Mount, tells disciples to pray against temptation, kneels, prays about the cup and divine will, receives angelic strengthening, and finds grief-filled sleep.
observations.label: On the Mount of Olives Jesus prays and finds sleeping disciples

observations.body: The passage presents Kneeling, praying, strengthening, sweating, and sleeping as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Kneeling, praying, strengthening, sweating, and sleeping

observations.body: The passage places Mount of Olives beside Kneeling, praying, strengthening, sweating, and sleeping.
observations.label: Mount of Olives

payload.posture: Read Luke 22:39–46 as one movement in the Last Supper, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The cup and the Father’s will
payload.title: On the Mount of Olives Jesus prays and finds sleeping disciples
